svg.title: 01. Straight knee calf stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Place your hands on the support. Step one foot back. Keep the back heel down and the back knee straight. Bend the front knee and move your body forwards.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.orthoinfo.org/recovery/foot-and-ankle-conditioning-program/
